Persijap Jepara vs Semen Padang: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the key battles for survival in the Indonesian Liga 1. At the Gelora Bumi Kartini Stadium, two newcomers to the top flight face off as Persijap Jepara hosts Semen Padang. In this 'six-pointer,' a positive result is vital for both teams.

Kick-off: November 20, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK) Stadium: Gelora Bumi Kartini Stadium, Jepara Competition: Indonesia Super League

Persijap Jepara vs Semen Padang: Match Preview

After their triumphant promotion from Liga 2, both teams have faced the harsh realities of the top division and are currently in the lower part of the league table. Their head-to-head clash is of colossal importance in the fight to stay in the elite. Persijap is traditionally strong at home, where the support of their fans is their main asset. Semen Padang will be looking to pick up crucial away points to improve their situation. The first top-flight derby between these newcomers promises to be uncompromising.

Team Form and Analysis

Persijap Jepara

The 'Kalinyamat Eagles' build their game on organized defense and fighting spirit. At home, the team will aim to play on the front foot and exploit the weaknesses of a direct competitor. However, Persijap's main problem remains their low productivity in attack. A win in this match is critically important for their future prospects in the league.

Semen Padang

The 'Red Buffalos' ('Kabau Sirah') are also experiencing difficulties at the start of their top-flight season. The team concedes a lot and is not consistent in away matches. All hopes in attack are pinned on Nigerian forward Kenneth Ngwoke, who was one of the top scorers last season. The visitors will try to impose a gritty, tough battle to snatch some points in this difficult away game.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persijap Jepara (4-2-3-1): Andika; Akbar, Harun, Ewolo, Roni; Haryo, Samuel; Habil, Basori, Rifai; Rodrigues.
  • Semen Padang (4-3-3): Anak; Gusmawan, Rosi, Mahamadu, Fadhillah; Iskandar, Correa, Ramadhan; Ngwoke, Irfandi, Firmansyah.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The outcome of a match between two evenly matched newcomers, both in desperate need of points, is extremely difficult to predict. Persijap has the home-field advantage, which is a significant factor in Indonesia. Semen Padang will likely focus on a defensive approach.

  • Main Prediction: Persijap to Win or Draw (1X). Playing at home against a direct rival for survival, the 'Kalinyamat Eagles' will give their all to at least pick up one point and avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams with obvious problems in attack, where the cost of every mistake is extremely high. A six-pointer match is likely to be cautious and not very high-scoring.

Surkhon vs AGMK: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 29th round of the Uzbekistan Super League, where Surkhon Termez hosts AGMK Olmaliq. This is a meeting of two mid-table teams looking to end their season on a high note.

Kick-off: November 20, 2025, 11:00 UTC (14:00 MSK) Stadium: Markaziy Stadion, Termez Competition: Uzbekistan Super League

Surkhon vs AGMK: Match Preview

The teams come into this head-to-head meeting in close proximity in the league table: AGMK is in 6th place, while Surkhon is in 10th. Surkhon has shown strong form at home, with three wins in their last six matches. AGMK, in contrast, has struggled significantly on the road, losing five of their last six away games. The head-to-head history favors AGMK, who have won half of the last six encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Surkhon

The Termez-based team is a solid mid-table side that is particularly resilient at home. In recent home matches, Surkhon has achieved good results, including victories over Shortan (1-0) and Andijon (4-0). The team will look to exploit AGMK's weaknesses in away games and aim for a positive result in their final home match of the season.

AGMK

The team from Olmaliq, despite their higher league standing, is experiencing serious issues in away matches. Five defeats in their last six away games indicate a deep crisis. AGMK will be motivated to end their poor away streak and finish the season strongly.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Surkhon (4-2-3-1): Yusupov; Alikulov, Puskarić, Sattorov, Asrorov; Abdurashidov, Asqarov; Toshpulatov, Makhmudkhujiev, Abdumannonov; Khoshimov.
  • AGMK (4-3-3): Rakhimov; Rakhmonov, Gafurov, Ismoilov, Akhmadaliev; Qosimov, Abdullayev, Rustamov; Toshmatov, Gadoev, Hagnawi.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although AGMK sits higher in the table and has the head-to-head advantage, their terrible away form makes Surkhon the favorite for this match.

  • Main Prediction: Surkhon to Win. The hosts perform confidently at home, while AGMK struggles in away matches. The home-field advantage should be crucial.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Matches between these teams rarely produce many goals. With both teams lacking high offensive efficiency, a tight, low-scoring contest is expected.

Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 13th round of the Indonesian Liga 1, where one of the main title contenders, Persija Jakarta, hosts Persik Kediri. This is a clash between one of the league leaders and a solid mid-table team.

Kick-off: November 20, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK) Stadium: Gelora Bung Karno Stadium, Jakarta Competition: Indonesia Super League

Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri: Match Preview

Persija Jakarta comes into this match as one of the league leaders, competing for the gold medals. Thomas Doll's side displays a very organized and tactically astute style of football. Persik Kediri, in turn, is a solid mid-table team that has already caused problems for the giants this season. The head-to-head history favors the capital club: Persija is unbeaten against Persik in the last six encounters, securing four wins.

Team Form and Analysis

Persija Jakarta

The 'Kemayoran Tigers' rely on a solid defense, which is one of the best in the league. At home, with the support of their fans, Persija is particularly formidable. In attack, the legendary Croatian striker Marko Šimić regularly scores in important matches. Persija will aim to extend their dominant run in matches against Persik and secure a crucial three points in the title race.

Persik Kediri

The 'White Tigers,' under Marcelo Rospide, are not afraid to play attacking football even against the leaders. The team will rely on fast wing attacks and set pieces. The leader of their attack is Portuguese forward Flávio Silva, who poses the main threat to the hosts' goal. The visitors will try to break their unlucky streak in matches against the capital club.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persija Jakarta (3-5-2): Andritany; Ferarri, Kúdela, Ridwan; Rio Fahmi, Gajos, Hannan, Matsumura, Firza; Riko Simanjuntak, Marko Šimić.
  • Persik Kediri (4-3-3): Diksa; Haikal, Cunha, Widodo, Yusak; Mealatana, Otto, Chand; Baihaki, Flávio Silva, Supriadi.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Persija Jakarta are the clear favorites for this match on their home turf. Their higher class, organization of play, and successful head-to-head history make a home win the most likely outcome. Persik is a resilient opponent, but it is unlikely they will be able to take points from Jakarta.

  • Main Prediction: Persija Jakarta to Win. The league leader must prove their class and take all three points in a home match against a mid-table team.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Persija has the best defense in the league and often plays low-scoring matches. 4 of the last 6 head-to-head meetings have seen fewer than three goals. A tactical battle with few goals is expected.

Pakhtakor vs Nasaf: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the main event of the 29th round, and possibly the entire Uzbekistan Super League championship, where Pakhtakor Tashkent hosts its main rival for the gold medals, Nasaf Qarshi. This is the 'Uzbek Clasico,' a battle between the two strongest teams in the country, the outcome of which could decide the fate of the championship title.

Kick-off: November 20, 2025, 13:15 UTC (16:15 MSK) Stadium: Pakhtakor Markaziy Stadium, Tashkent Competition: Uzbekistan Super League

Pakhtakor vs Nasaf: Match Preview

Both teams come into this 'golden match' as the two league leaders. Throughout the season, Pakhtakor and Nasaf have been engaged in a fierce battle for first place, and their head-to-head meeting in the penultimate round is the culmination of this race. Nasaf approaches the match in phenomenal form, being unbeaten for a long time and boasting the best defense in the league. Pakhtakor, in turn, is the most prolific team in the championship and is traditionally dominant at home. The history of encounters between these teams is always incredibly tense, but in recent matches, Nasaf has had a slight edge, winning two of the last three meetings, including the Uzbekistan Cup final.

Team Form and Analysis

Pakhtakor

The 'Lions' will be highly motivated to get revenge for recent setbacks against Nasaf and take a decisive step towards the championship in front of their home fans. The team relies on an attacking, combination-based style of football and the high individual skill of its leaders, such as Dragan Ćeran and Khojimat Erkinov. Pakhtakor will look to seize the initiative and apply pressure from the first minutes.

Nasaf

The 'Dragons,' under Ruziqul Berdiev, are known for their tactical discipline and impenetrable defense. The team is adept at playing on the counter and launching devastating breaks. Nasaf will aim to at least avoid defeat in Tashkent to maintain their advantage or decide the title's fate in the final round. Key players in the squad include Uzbekistan national team members Oybek Bozorov and Sherzod Nasrullaev.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Pakhtakor (4-3-3): Kuvvatov; Alijonov, Azmiddinov, Tursunov, Sayfiev; Khamrobekov, Kholmatov, Sobirjonov; Turgunboev, Ćeran, Erkinov.
  • Nasaf (4-2-3-1): Nematov; Nasrullaev, Davronov, Golban, Alikulov; Mukhiddinov, Mozgovoy; Norchaev, Stanojević, Bozorov; Lima.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between the two best teams in the country is completely unpredictable. Pakhtakor has the home-field advantage and a more potent attack. Nasaf, however, is in better current form and has the most reliable defense.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a 'golden match' where the cost of a mistake is incredibly high, neither team will take unnecessary risks. A draw, which would keep the suspense alive until the final round, looks the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of the two best defenses in the league. 4 of the last 5 head-to-head meetings have been low-scoring. A tight, tactical battle with a minimal number of goals is expected.
